notes.title: Various specification changes
notes.content:
・The ghosts will not attack until the berserkness value is exceeded.
・The color of the orb changes when the ghost goes berserk.
・The screen shaking when they attack has been reduced.
・The blue-haired ghosts that always go berserk will now have their photo ranks always increased.
・The rank of the photo will be increased by 1 or 2 depending on the size of the map.
・Fixed a problem with ghosts going out of range of the map.
・Changed so that the distance is not determined when the ghost is on a different floor.
・Increased the amount of time ghosts can stay in one place, depending on the size of the map.

notes.title: Expansion of search range
notes.content:
Expands the range of presence when the eyes are closed.
The search range is originally expanded according to the size of the map, but the range is now expanded as a whole.

notes.title: Adjustment of out-of-breath and addition of tips
notes.content:
・The effect of remaining breath on running distance has been reduced.
・The amount by which the breath gauge decreases with distance from the ghost has been reduced.
・Added tips to the Loading screen.

notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented photos from being saved & improved functionality
notes.content:
・Fixed a problem that prevented photos from being saved.
　Set a wait time for saving, since the saving process may not be completed depending on the PC performance and load condition.
・Fixed wrong rage gauges for some ghosts.
・Adjusted hunt time.
・Added an icon to make it easier to tell when a ghost is holding its breath.
